scope: One same-shape nonranking WindowsVulkan candidate observation. Read-only source/manifest/build-run helper and necessary original scheduler/help review. Reviewer performed no configure/build/native/GPU/profile/A/A/P1.

checks.finding: Read actual unified differences against ae521 original invocation and immutable facade. Only extern record declaration, equivalent poll wrapper, original progress/finished wait wrappers and frontier wait records were inserted. Original conditions, locks, wait arguments, Completion waits, math, ownership and RunState fields are unchanged. facade adds enter/after-State-replay markers and post-close flush. driver.cc and facade_api.h are byte-identical to original. source-proof PASS_STATIC_ONLY is consistent with those direct reads, not a runtime certificate.

Relaxed fetch_add reserves distinct slots but is NOT a publication/release protocol for Record fields; used.load(acquire) alone would not make concurrent flush safe. Here added writers run only on caller or original Sched drivers. State.close closes every slot without early return, then Scheduler.drain; drain acquire-observes the acq_rel outstanding decrements after fiber finish hooks. Caller records are sequenced before flush. The fixed driver has one State per image at a time and synchronous replay/finish, so no remaining writer races flush/reset. This does not license concurrent States/flush or foreign callback writers. Overflow is reported and destroy returns error; no silent truncation PASS.

Kind3 is after State.replay and its original Drain return but before the C status formatter/return; it is not driver-side return. Poll tokens are Completion object addresses and may be reused; combine image, enclosing State replay interval, joint RunState and temporal lifetime before attributing them. Concurrent producer timestamp order need not equal reserved slot order, so analysis must use recorded times/thread/lifetimes rather than assume rows are clock-sorted. Native public terminal may be poll-driven; these records do not supply independent native-ready time.
checks.clock: QPC converted to integer ns. NVTX payload is QPC before nvtxMarkEx and kind2 has QPC after. Actual trace must support a consistent bounded offset interval; source markers alone do not prove the mapping. GPU batch end is not checked public completion. Record/marker overhead and profiler threads remain diagnostic UNKNOWN, not P1.

checks.item: One local externC recorder per image
checks.finding: The invocation object has only one global externC g09_record declaration. Only facade.cc includes the defining recorder header; wrapper/unchanged driver do not. One direct invocation object plus one facade TU is linked into each of two separate PE DLLs. Original graph_route_cpu_vulkan static target has no declared whole-archive extraction in this seam. PE local resolution is plausible; a successful build and actual maps/imports/exports are still necessary to prove no original invocation member, no duplicate or cross-image recorder binding.

Only static Windows qualified SDK imports, four compile records (one invocation, two facade, one wrapper), original imported nanobench archive, LTO off, no SDK/native/kernel targets. Builder refuses existing build/logs, hashes source manifest and unchanged owner source, checks exactly4 compile commands and small dry run, uses2jobs/BelowNormal/up-to4logical CPUs, retains failures and same-PID timeout extensions. Runtime copy/actual artifact/map capture occurs only after build; no application command is present.

checks.item: Owned failure cleanup and run gate
checks.finding: Both helpers stop still-live owned Popen trees on exceptions and wait the owned parent. Nsight target may outlive profiler: run helper also checks the nonce-bound emitted PID, current full exe path equals this unique diagnostic image, and terminates/waits only that owned target. Wrapper sets/checks actual AboveNormal32768/0x14, then original caller affinity/QoS and emits normal business-return code. No broad process kill or restart. Run requires not-yet-generated auth and actual build metadata/artifact hashes; ordinary OBS env is set and external CUDA/NVTX injection rejected.

Read retained installed-tool help: trace vulkan,nvtx, GPU batch activity, sample/cpuctxsw/backtrace none, wait primary, stop-on-exit true, kill true and show-output true have stated syntax. Only this owned process is intended; no CUDA/WDDM/CPU sampling requested. No profiler was invoked by reviewer. Successful injection, permissions, target exit, GPU workload/submission attribution, dropped data and clock alignment remain unknown until the one authorized capture. CAPTURED_NOT_INTERPRETED is correctly weaker than qualification.

required_before_profile: Actual build terminal, exact4 compile inputs/flags/include SDK identity and original nanobench object identity.

Both actual maps: replacement invocation object fulfills relevant symbols; original archive invocation member not extracted; g09_record and its record storage resolve inside each own image. Inspect actual exports/imports and linked SDK closure; do not infer solely from absence of link error.
Hash actual DLLs/driver, maps, SDK/runtime/resources, source manifest/proof, reviewed helpers and this review; bind to one fixed build/run paths and immutable auth.

Keep one candidate-first/allocation-first candidate self-pair process, original4 shapes/4M/8warmups/12paired/exact1 and complete oracles/retirement. No original A/A/P1 qualification or estimator change.
Only then may root freeze the one profile permission. Runtime attribution/clock failures or record overflow remain UNKNOWN/FAIL and stop; no retry or further profiler framework.

limits: This is validation-copy instrumentation, not a product FIX or public API/layout change. The source records add perturbation and are not ranking evidence.
Scheduler drain proves this recorder HB only because all inserted writers are caller/Sched and the fixed per-image State lifetime is serial. No general concurrent recorder API is signed.
No actual map/compiled object, native dispatch, profiler capture, dropped-record count, GPU-to-host clock mapping or native completion attribution is signed by this source phase.
Initial nonranking numeric tables from unchanged driver remain diagnostics and cannot repair or replace any retained A/A FAIL.
